title: Glokzin Teal Makeup Mirror, 8-Inch Double-Sided 2X, Freestanding Solid Brass, Adjustable Height, Allied Brass
description: Make-up mirror for bathroom vanity use with 8 inches / 8-inch / 8in diameter double-faced mirror glass — available in Glokzin Teal, which delivers rich, jewel-toned sophistication, adding artistic depth and a designer touch to modern bathrooms. This freestanding mirror (free standing vanity mirror) is adjustable height and designed for daily makeup application and shaving. Dual-sided magnifying mirror: 2X magnification on one side and a regular 1X mirror on the opposite side for a quick overall check. Solid brass construction (brass makeup mirror) with traditional style accents; heavy solid brass base helps prevent tipping. Felt pad helps prevent scratching on countertops and other surfaces. Product dimensions: 10.5 in L x 56-68 in H x 10.5 in W. Some assembly required. Assembled in the U.S.A. Backed by a lifetime warranty. Allied Brass.
